newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline off $3.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline off $3.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday in generally thin trade.
Gasoline fell $3 a tonne in Europe as relentless selling by Rotterdam refiners continued to punch prices lower.
Naphtha was steady on the back of broadly unchanged crude, but demand was lacklustre.
Gas oil premiums were holding, bar narrowly weaker heating barge premiums. Futures were unchanged.
High sulphur fuel barges slipped $1 in thin trade to $83/$84 fob ARA but high sulphur cargoes steadied. Low sulphur cargoes were weaker, talked around $100 cif Med.
